text: Long coffee with Kofi. His daughter Amara starts reception on September 4th and he's more nervous than she is. His mum is coming over from Accra to help with pickups for the first month. Remind me to text him that morning.
Caught up with Deepa after yoga. Her son Arjun has his GCSE maths Friday and has barely slept. She's taking him for pancakes after. Her husband is away in Leeds all week so she's doing it solo.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning tomorrow before 5 and drop the parcel back at the post office.

Rang Zeynep. Mehmet graduates from Edinburgh on June 28th, first in the family to finish uni. Her parents are flying in for it. She wants to find him a decent watch, apparently he keeps hinting at a Seiko.
Hana says her little brother Nikhil passed his driving test second time round! Mum's letting him borrow the car this weekend. Should send him a quick well done.

Bumped into Rebecca at the school gate. Her twins start Year 1 next Tuesday and the older one, Isla, is dreading the new teacher. Rebecca's mum broke her wrist last week so she's been doing all the runs. Ask her Thursday how the first days went.
Me: dentist 5/14 at 9.15, car MOT the week after. Book the time off.
Ciara called, upset. Her dad's surgery got moved to October 30th and her brother Sam can't get back from Dubai in time. She's handling the hospital stuff on her own. Must ring her on the 29th.
Mandla's kid finished his first week of nursery and apparently loved it, cried when it was time to go home lol. Mandla's partner Leah goes back to work Monday.
Note: Mariam is vegetarian, her husband Mustafa doesn't eat pork, and their youngest is allergic to sesame. For the bbq.
Sophie and her partner are moving to Bristol in a fortnight. Her mum is not thrilled about it. Sophie starts at the new practice on the 3rd.

Lunch with Aiko and Zhang. Aiko's daughter got into the Royal College of Music, starts in the fall, and Aiko is beside herself. Zhang's son sits his A levels from May 12th through June 20th, so he's in full revision mode and Zhang's barely seeing him. Zhang mentioned his wife Vera wants to redo the kitchen once exams are done. Remind me to send Aiko flowers this week and check how Zhang's lad is doing mid-June.
Divya mentioned her nan turns 90 on March 3rd. Big family lunch at the Indian place on the high street. Think about a card.
Grocery run Saturday. Also need to renew passport before July.
The christening for Elena's baby is off, the priest is ill. They're rescheduling for sometime in spring. Elena seemed fine about it honestly.
Natasha's son Hoang got his uni results back today. 2:1 in engineering! Graduation is July 17th. Natasha said his dad cried on the phone. Don't forget to send a card.
Quick call with Nora. Her mum's been diagnosed with early dementia. Nora's sister Alessia is moving back from Milan to help out. Nora sounded exhausted. Check in with her next weekend.
Kemal's nervous about his presentation to the board on Wednesday. His boss is apparently a nightmare. Text him good luck Tuesday night.
Followed up with Arjun about the interview he had Monday. He thinks it went okay but they won't know till next Friday. His girlfriend Sofia is convinced he's got it.
Aoife loves gardening, grows her own tomatoes, hates coriander. Her kids are 6 and 9.
Sorted the boiler service for Thursday morning. Still need to cancel the gym membership.

Ran into Mrs Williams at the shop. Her grandson Kemal is off to Istanbul for a year on May 30th for his studies. She's knitting him a jumper. Her husband had a fall in August but he's recovering well.
Vera says Alina has her ballet exam 6/9 and is practising every evening in the living room. Their cat Biscuit keeps getting in the way lol.
Deepa's daughter Divya got her first tooth out yesterday. Tooth fairy left £2 apparently, inflation.
Rang Mehmet for his birthday. He's 40 on Sunday, Zeynep is throwing him a surprise party at the Turkish restaurant. Don't let slip. I'm bringing the cake.
Kofi's wife Amara is expecting again, due in early April! Their son Mandla is thrilled about being a big brother. Kofi's taking paternity leave the whole month.
Hana and her husband are celebrating 10 years married on the 22nd. They're going to Kyoto. Their dog Mochi is going to her mum's.

Spoke to Sophie Dubois at the PTA meeting. Her son Nikhil has his 11 plus on September 12th and she's frantic about tutoring. Her husband thinks they're pushing him too hard. She asked if I knew a good maths tutor, should ask Leah if she still does it.
Called Mum. Picking her up from the station on Friday at 6.
Ciara's son Hoang just started secondary. He's finding the bus really hard and she's worried about the older kids picking on him.
Remind me to ask Mandla how his daughter's school play went. It was last Thursday.
Isla mentioned her brother Mustafa just got engaged to Nina! Wedding probably next summer. Isla's maid of honour, already panicking.
Elena is coeliac. Her partner Nora does all the cooking. They've got a rescue greyhound called Pepper.
Book return train tickets for 12/20, pay council tax, and order more printer ink.
Alessia says her dad retires on Friday after 35 years at the post office. Big do at the social club Saturday. Get a card for Alessia to pass on.

Lunch with Rebecca and Aiko. Rebecca's boy Kofi starts at Manchester uni in two weeks and Rebecca's driving him up on the 21st. Aiko's husband just lost his job, she's trying not to show how stressed she is. Rebecca's mum is moving in with them in November. Aiko said she'd love a pottery class voucher for her birthday, it's next month.
Sofia's little one, Nina, had her first swimming lesson today. Hated it. Going again Saturday.
Must remember: Zhang Lee's daughter graduates from nursing school May 23rd. He asked if I can come.

Divya and Mariam both mentioned that Natasha's mum died on Sunday. The funeral is next Wednesday at 11. Natasha's brother is flying back from Toronto tomorrow. Send Natasha a message tonight and sort flowers for Wednesday.
Caught up with Mustafa, hasn't changed. Still mad about Arsenal, still working at the bank, still single.
Took the car in today. Should be ready Monday. Need to sort a hire car till then.
Aoife's daughter Ciara got into the county hockey team! Training every Tuesday and Thursday. Aoife's husband is driving her as Aoife works late.
Hoang mentioned his mum's 60th is on April 9th. He's organising a family meal and wants a photo book for her. Help him find old photos, he asked. Also Hoang's sister Leah is pregnant, due August.

Saw Nikhil yesterday, he's been struggling since the breakup with Divya. Living back at his parents'. He's got a job interview at the council next Thursday. Text him Wednesday evening to wish him luck, and check in properly at the weekend.
Kemal Haddad's son Mehmet failed his driving test this morning. Third time. Retaking in six weeks. Kemal reckons he's more upset than he lets on.
Just me this weekend: clear the loft Saturday, Ikea Sunday, call the landlord about the leak Monday.
Alina's moving out of her parents' place on the 15th, into a flat share in Hackney. Her mum is helping with the deposit. Alina starts her first proper job at the agency on the 18th.
Deepa Kaur says her mother-in-law is staying for six weeks from Thursday. She's already counting the days lol. Her husband Arjun thinks it'll be fine.
Isla's daughter Sophie started university at Durham. She FaceTimes home every night. Isla's struggling with the empty nest. Must take her out for coffee next week.
Mariam's son passed his piano grade 5 with distinction. She's really proud, he practised every day for months.
Vera and her husband Mandla are off to Lisbon on the 3rd for a week. Their son Kemal is minding the house and the two cats. Vera says Mandla wants a new camera lens for Christmas.
Elena's daughter Zeynep had her graduation ceremony on Saturday. Elena sent me loads of photos, everyone in tears. Ask Elena which job Zeynep's going for next.
Called Amara. Her dad's back in hospital since Monday, they think it's his heart. Her brother Kofi is with him tonight. She's going up tomorrow and staying till Sunday.
Nora's son started his apprenticeship as an electrician last week. Loving it so far. Nora's thrilled he didn't go to uni after all.
Leah's daughter has chicken pox so the birthday party Saturday is cancelled. Moving it to the 28th maybe.
Mehmet says Ciara is training for the Dublin half marathon October 26th. Running every morning before work. He's going over to watch her. I should message her the night before.
Order Mum's birthday present by Wednesday so it arrives in time for 3/11.

Catch-up with Natasha and Hana. Natasha's son Arjun has his A level results on August 14th, she can't sleep. Hana's mum is having her knee done on the 20th and Hana is taking her to the hospital. Natasha said her husband Zhang has been doing night shifts since June. Hana's thinking of moving closer to her mum next year. Text Natasha on results day and ring Hana the day after the op.
Sofia's son Mustafa lost his first football match yesterday, 4-0. He was gutted. She said he's already asking for new boots, maybe I can get him some for his birthday.
Alessia Johnson has been made head of year at the primary school. Starts after half term. Her kids Nina and Hana are mortified their mum will be in charge lol.
